events.name: The Albert Kidd Final

events.name: The Stripped Title
events.note: Won the Champions League, then had the 1992-93 French title stripped and were forcibly relegated over the VA-OM affair. The only French European champion, punished at home in the same breath. Administrative wound, priced like Administration/Deductions but heavier.

events.name: The Guttmann Curse
events.note: Béla Guttmann, sacked in 1962: 'not in a hundred years will Benfica win a European Cup.' Eusébio prayed at his grave in Vienna before the 1990 final, held in Vienna. Benfica lost 1-0. Eight European finals lost since the curse. Prices the folklore of the standing curse at its most vivid moment, not any individual's death.

events.name: Three Posts in Amsterdam
events.note: 1992 UEFA Cup final, second leg away to Ajax: 0-0, Torino hit the woodwork three times, lose the trophy on away goals. The sporting wound Gemini asked for; Superga remains outside the pang layer per the taste ruling.
